title: Alpha Lab bounded Form-4 falsification experiment
goal: Preserve the completed lawful point-in-time data foundation, execute exactly one cheap preregistered Form-4 kill test, and stop with a published no-go whenever free lawful data or robustness gates fail. Alpha Lab is a bounded secondary experiment, not the primary revenue path, and has no automatic prospective-shadow or capital progression.
completion: T001 is evidence-bound to the merged Alpha Lab data-foundation implementation and its green Python 3.10 and 3.12 checks.

T002 preregisters and runs one fixed 20-trading-day kill test using only lawful free data, at least 200 issuer-independent events, public-release timing, fixed costs, fixed baselines and automatic no-go criteria.

The initiative terminates with a full no-go result or an independent-review request. The former T003 six-month cohort is superseded; any prospective work requires a new task and explicit opportunity-cost review.

scope_revision.reason: The full historical plus six-month shadow programme was too slow, data-heavy and capital-constrained to justify priority as a Schotter path.
